title: 14 Best Airtable Alternatives in 2026
summary: Airtable alternatives provide specialized features for teams needing higher row limits, complex relational databases, or lower monthly subscription costs.
body_markdown:
## Activepieces for automating your chosen database alternative


Activepieces is an MIT-licensed AI automation platform that runs a company's chosen models across its own apps and data, providing a scalable way to replicate Airtable's native suite for teams using cost-effective database alternatives.


Every catalogue is a ceiling, but the Activepieces MIT-licensed core acts as a floor; users can generate missing integrations with AI and add them privately, rather than waiting on a vendor's roadmap.


Roughly 60% of the 735+ integrations in the monorepo are community-contributed, ensuring that niche database connectors remain available without being limited by a single vendor's release priorities, which means the platform's utility scales far beyond the core development team's immediate roadmap.


The platform relies on a visual flow builder to eliminate the need for custom Python scripts when connecting disparate tools.


Activepieces provides unlimited flows on every plan, including free, so a business can pair a high-performance database like Baserow with their existing stack to achieve enterprise-level automation without the **per-seat tax** associated with all-in-one platforms.


### Model selection in Activepieces


Activepieces lets you bring your own provider key for any major model, so model spend lands on your bill rather than being marked up by the automation vendor.


[Docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/about-claude/models/overview) notes that this orchestrator lets users swap between different providers based on the specific requirements of the task.


When latency is the primary bottleneck, users can select Gemini 3.8 Flash for high-speed, high-volume agentic workflows.


They can use[Claude](https://claude.com/pricing) Opus 5.5 for long-running, complex knowledge work that requires deep reasoning and a large context window.


Finally, GPT-6 Sol is available for advanced coding tasks and autonomous agentic workflows that require the latest frontier reasoning capabilities.


By decoupling the automation layer from the database itself, businesses avoid the "feature creep" pricing that occurs when a database provider tries to be an all-in-one productivity suite. This separation ensures that as your data grows, your ability to automate it remains flexible and cost-controlled.


By shifting the billing metric from individual actions to the flow run itself, Activepieces eliminates the financial penalty typically associated with building complex, multi-step database workflows.


Activepieces is the better choice for organizations scaling high-volume data operations that require predictable costs regardless of how many steps or modules a process contains.


While competitors charge for every task or module executed, this platform allows users to build sophisticated integrations without the overhead of per-step pricing.
